description: This file defines the core data structures and logic for managing instances (nodes) within the application, including fetching presence data, handling push events, maintaining connection states, and notifying on node connections.

classes.name: InstancesStore
classes.description: An observable singleton class that manages the list of instances, handles refresh logic, push notifications, and presence state updates.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins listening for presence updates and push notifications, initiating background tasks.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the background tasks related to presence updates and push notifications.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the current presence data from the control channel and updates the instances list accordingly.

methods.name: localFallbackInstance
methods.description: Constructs a fallback InstanceInfo representing the local machine when no external presence data is available.

methods.name: decodeAndApplyPresenceData
methods.description: Decodes raw presence payload data and applies it to update internal state.

methods.name: handlePresenceEventPayload
methods.description: Handles incoming presence event payloads from push notifications.

methods.name: normalizePresence
methods.description: Converts raw presence entries into standardized InstanceInfo objects.

methods.name: applyPresence
methods.description: Updates internal presence state with new presence entries.

methods.name: notifyOnNodeLogin
methods.description: Sends notifications when new nodes connect.

methods.name: snippet
methods.description: Utility to generate a short string snippet of raw data for logging.

methods.name: probeHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Performs a health check of the control channel if needed.
